snippet.title: Japanese Swordsmith — Coming Soon Trailer
snippet.description:
From tamahagane to a finished katana. Become a swordsmith in Bakumatsu Kyoto—sumikiri, mizuheshi, folding forge, the quench, polishing—and finish a Japanese sword with your own hands. A hardcore swordsmith simulator.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4958850/
